title: Split crates/nodes/src/architecture.rs into an architecture/ submodule (over 500-line standard)
description: architecture.rs is ~700 lines, over the project's 500-line-per-file standard (see .llm/findings/architecture-node.md Deferred Issue #3). Mirror the executor/{mod,steps,dispatch,completion,runner}.rs split precedent: break into architecture/mod.rs + architecture/generation.rs + architecture/alignment.rs (or similar). Flagged in PR #184 review by the Claude GitHub Action.

title: Decide real source for ArchitectureNode's cross-domain extracted InterfaceMap (currently vacuous fail-closed-empty)
description: ArchitectureNode::execute's cross_domain_blocking_findings (crates/nodes/src/architecture.rs) validates registry contracts against an unconditionally-empty InterfaceMap, since no DomainServiceClient::extract_interfaces source exists at the Architecture stage. This is either a silent no-op (empty registry) or an unconditional blocking failure (any populated registry) - never a genuine comparison. Already tracked as Medium security finding #1 in .llm/findings/architecture-node.md and Spec Gap #3 in the same file. Needs an explicit Architect decision before any registry with real entries goes live: either (a) build the InterfaceMap from the LLM's proposed interface changes in the architecture document output, or (b) skip the check entirely (with a loud audit-trail warning) when no extractor is available, instead of the current always-vacuous behaviour. Flagged again in PR #184 review by the Claude GitHub Action.
